description: workflow contract profile keys that the model's own state Selection can never produce. state_phase and state_actions are read with the record's raw state as the key, so these entries are dead configuration: harmless at runtime, but they hide the fact that the profile and the model disagree. The guard refuses an unregistered dead entry and a stale registration, so the set is explicit and cannot grow unnoticed.
registry_rule: A state_phase or state_actions key that the model's state Selection cannot produce must be listed here with its exact key set and a reason, or removed from the profile. Entries go stale when the computed set changes.

entries.reason: the shared _confirm_done_profiles template declares both cancel/cancelled and legacy_confirmed; this model's Selection cannot produce the listed keys, so the entries are unreachable
